clue.text: Flint workers hold fish to ransom

definitions.note: read with 'hold', the definition names people who hold others to ransom

indicators.note: the flint workers hold the fish, so its letters sit inside theirs

parts.note: knappers are craftsmen who chip flint into tools
the ide, also spelt id, is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Stone craftsmen grab a fish and demand payment for its return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hold' works twice in the surface: as the container signal, and inside the definition read as 'hold ... to ransom'. Flint knapping is the old craft of shaping stone tools.
explanation.definitionFit: Abductors are the criminals who seize people and demand payment for their release.

clue.text: Issues new jokes

definitions.meaning: to joke is to tease or josh

explanation.definitionFit: Children are a family's offspring, and to josh someone is to tease them playfully.

clue.text: Fled over hole in the ground

indicators.note: over asks for the word fled to be turned round and read backwards

explanation.surface: Someone ran off over a hole in the ground.
explanation.walkthrough: A delf is a dialect word for a pit or quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: A delf is a pit or quarry dug into the earth, a dialect term.

clue.text: Lie in wait to see president after a great many

indicators.note: after places the president's name behind the letters for a great many

parts.note: M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for a great many
Bush was the surname of two US presidents

explanation.surface: Someone waits patiently for a glimpse of the president after many others have gone before.
explanation.definitionFit: To ambush is to hide and attack by surprise, keeping hidden until the target comes.

clue.text: Shock treatment has long lasting effect

definitions.text: Shock treatment has long lasting effect

parts.words: Shock treatment has long lasting effect
parts.note: a shock is a mass of hair, so its treatment is a hairdressing process whose curls last a long time

explanation.surface: Electroconvulsive therapy leaves a patient changed for a long time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock' suggests electric shock therapy; it means a head of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A perm is a chemical hairdressing process giving curls that last for months.

clue.text: Honey badgers one values about a pound

indicators.note: the word for values goes about the pound, holding it inside

parts.note: to rate is to value, so values gives rates
L, from libra, is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: Someone prices honey badgers at about a pound each.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratels are the African and Asian carnivores also called honey badgers.

clue.text: Silences the jokes that get one down

definitions.meaning: to silence someone is to muzzle or stifle them

definitions.text: the jokes that get one down
definitions.meaning: comic jokes, and the playful sense of getting one down is a joke wearing a listener out

explanation.definitionFit: A gag is both a cloth stifling speech and a comedian's one-liner.

clue.text: Firm's structure has one but companies do not

definitions.text: Firm's structure has one but companies do not

parts.words: Firm's structure has one but companies do not
parts.note: read as spelling, the written word Firm's carries a punctuation mark while the plural companies has none

explanation.surface: One business has an organisational structure that others lack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'structure' points to how a business is organised; it means how the word is written.
explanation.definitionFit: The punctuation mark showing possession appears in the written form Firm's and not in the plural.

clue.text: Naughty devil sires in such a joint

indicators.note: naughty suggests the letters misbehave and are put out of order

explanation.surface: A wicked devil fathers children in a cut of beef.
explanation.definitionFit: Silverside is a cut of beef from the outside of the hindquarter, a joint for roasting or salting.

clue.text: Think positively intentional

definitions.meaning: to think carefully over something before deciding
something done on purpose, quite consciously

explanation.definitionFit: To weigh something up is to ponder it, and a planned act is done on purpose.

clue.text: Garbo ill-advised having to seethe

indicators.note: having means the words contain the answer's letters inside them

explanation.surface: Greta Garbo, badly advised, is left fuming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ill-advised' looks like an anagram signal, but the letters run across Garbo and ill.
explanation.definitionFit: To seethe is to bubble with rage, as water bubbles when heated.

clue.text: Dish out today when I enter cathedral

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the present era

indicators.note: I enter means the letter goes inside the cathedral word

parts.note: a minster is a large church, as in York Minster

explanation.surface: Someone serves food when they go into a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: To administer is to dispense or give out, as with medicine or punishment.

clue.text: Recorder to prepare reports about a terror pup

indicators.note: about here means the letters are moved round into a new order

explanation.surface: A clerk writes up a report on a scary puppy.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapporteur is an official appointed to investigate and report to a committee.

clue.text: It goes with a battery to show up in court

definitions.text: It goes with a battery to show up in court

parts.words: It goes with a battery to show up in court
parts.note: the legal pairing of charges, the threat and the battery, which together bring someone before a judge

explanation.surface: Something paired with a power cell appears before a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'battery' suggests a power cell; it is the crime of physical attack.
explanation.definitionFit: The criminal charge commonly paired with battery is a threatened or actual attack.

clue.text: Shot at first allure

indicators.note: first places the little word at ahead of the word for allure

parts.note: to allure is to tempt or entice

explanation.surface: A gunshot fired at first draws someone in.
explanation.definitionFit: A shot is a try, as in having a go at something.

clue.text: Agony to trot over the river

indicators.note: over turns the word trot round so it reads backwards

parts.note: the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Being made to jog across the river is painful.
explanation.walkthrough: TROT turned over gives TORT; the Ure is a Yorkshire river.
explanation.definitionFit: Torture is extreme suffering, physical or mental.

clue.text: He'd returned with art in short supply

indicators.note: art goes in, placed inside the other piece
returned means the letters of he'd are read backwards

parts.note: the contraction gives the letters H, E and D, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A man came back with artworks that were scarce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns the contraction round to give DEH, and 'in' then places the artwork word in the middle of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A dearth is a scarcity or lack of something.

clue.text: Kind, that is Sally

parts.note: a kind is a sort or type
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A kindly woman named Sally is introduced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally' looks like a name; it is a sudden charge out of a besieged place.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a sudden attack by troops breaking out, also called a sortie.

clue.text: Executions made to sit on impalement

indicators.note: made suggests the letters are made into something new, rearranged

explanation.surface: Gruesome executions were carried out by impaling people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Executions' suggests killings, but means carrying out plans.
explanation.definitionFit: Executions in the sense of carrying out plans or putting policies into effect.

clue.text: It holds up sound of contented cat with flare

indicators.note: holds means the word it wraps round the other piece
in a down entry, up reads the cat's sound backwards

parts.note: a happy cat purrs

explanation.surface: Something lifts a purring cat that then flares.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the purr round, as this entry reads upwards in the grid; irrupt, to burst in, is not erupt, to burst out.
explanation.definitionFit: To irrupt is to burst in suddenly, a violent flare-up of activity.

clue.text: Thai covers 50/50 of plant parts

indicators.note: covers means the word Thai wraps round the other piece

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty, so two fifties give two Ls

explanation.surface: A Thai person splits plants half and half.
explanation.definitionFit: Thalli are simple plant bodies without true stems, roots or leaves, as in algae and lichens.

clue.text: Force from outside concealed the flower

indicators.note: taking the outside away from force leaves only its inner letters

parts.note: concealed means hid

explanation.surface: Someone forcibly hid a flower from those outside.
explanation.definitionFit: The orchid is an exotic flowering plant prized for its blooms.

clue.text: Rhetorician at dividing options

indicators.note: dividing means at splits the pair of option words

parts.note: or introduces an alternative, so two options give or and or

explanation.surface: A speechmaker weighs up competing choices.
explanation.definitionFit: An orator is a skilled public speaker, master of rhetoric.

clue.text: It will end fever again in operating room

indicators.note: the end of It means its final letter only

parts.note: heat is a feverish state or high temperature
re- is a prefix meaning again

explanation.surface: A patient's fever will break in the surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: An operating theatre is the hospital room where surgery is carried out.

clue.text: He leaves the layer at that time

indicators.note: He leaves means those two letters are taken out

parts.note: taken as written
a hen lays eggs, so a layer is a hen

explanation.surface: A man walks out on the egg-laying bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'layer' looks like a stratum; it is a bird that lays eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Then means at that particular past or future moment.

clue.text: It's for a Malayan boat

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of

explanation.surface: Something is suited to a boat from Malaya.
explanation.definitionFit: A proa is a fast outrigger sailing boat of the Malay archipelago.

clue.text: One may perform at matinée sounding idle

indicators.note: sounding means the word is heard spoken, not seen written

parts.note: idle means lazy or inactive

explanation.surface: An actor in an afternoon show seems lazy.
explanation.walkthrough: A matinée idol is a handsome actor adored by audiences.
explanation.definitionFit: A matinée idol is a heart-throb actor of stage or screen.

clue.text: So derelict and in ruins or shut up in monastery

indicators.note: in ruins means the letters are wrecked and rebuilt in another order

explanation.surface: A tumbledown monastery holds monks shut away.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloistered means secluded in a religious house, cut off from the world.

clue.text: Right outside or in the middle its a racket

indicators.note: the right letter and the middle of its go outside the word or
the middle of the word its is its centre letter

explanation.surface: A scam happens whether right outside or in the middle of things.
explanation.walkthrough: Rort is Australian slang for a scam or swindle; the apostrophe in the clue's its is missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Rort is Australian slang for a dishonest scheme or swindle.

clue.text: Quick, where it's on your hand!

definitions.text: Quick, where it's on your hand!

parts.words: Quick, where it's on your hand!
parts.note: the quick is the tender flesh beneath a nail, so this asks what lies over the quick on a hand

explanation.surface: An urgent question about where something is on your hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick' reads as hurry; it is the sensitive flesh under a nail.
explanation.definitionFit: The quick is the flesh under the horny plate at each fingertip.
